name: stair_chirp
character: The chirped echo of a clap on a stepped pyramid: a short descending chirp, about an octave down, that repeats as the sound runs down the steps.
sources: Nature news, 14 Dec 2004, on the chirped echo of El Castillo, Chichen Itza: https://www.nature.com/news/2004/041213/full/news041213-5.html

Search-result summaries of Lubman (1998-2002) and Declercq: reflections from the treads make the echo fall by about an octave, and the effect depends on the exciting sound; whether it was designed is debated
ESTIMATE: 2600 to 1300 Hz and 260-340 ms are read from "about an octave" in those summaries, not measured
